note: Every gate records 'validatedPortion' (proven by committed evidence) and 'deferredPortion' (requires the WP7 real-provider canary). A gate is not PASS unless BOTH columns are satisfied; deferred portions keep production enablement blocked.

runtime.algorithm: sha256 over sorted (relativePath \0 fileSha256 \0) pairs of the whole glm resource directory

evidenceIntegrity.historicalConfigRead: The ORIGINAL WP0 isolation helper copied model/provider metadata from the machine's real ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (replacing the apiKey before writing the isolated copy). No secret value was found in committed evidence (secret scans clean; committed fixtures contain only placeholder/model metadata). The helper has since been rewritten (deterministic closure) to build a fully synthetic throwaway config and no longer reads the real file. Claims of 'zero credential reads' for the historical runs were inaccurate and have been removed.
evidenceIntegrity.g6Statefulness: The G6 probe performs a STATEFUL session/resume over probe-owned history (which may persist a session.resumed event); it is not read-only. It now fails closed unless WP0_ALLOW_STATEFUL_PROBES=1 is set with explicit authorization.
evidenceIntegrity.syntheticConfigSchema: Deterministic closure follow-up (2026-08-30): the FIRST synthetic config was NOT accepted by the real app-server — session/create returned model_config_missing because the schema refines model references to provider/model form (bundle functions Yhr/Yp) and the bare model id made the whole model section parse to undefined. The shared generator (test/fixtures/synthetic-zcode-config.mjs) now emits the minimal schema-exact config (provider/model ref, kind openai-compatible, unreachable loopback baseURL, DUMMY-NOT-A-SECRET), proven by the real app-server lifecycle CANARY (test/real-app-server-lifecycle.canary.ts, explicit entry test:real-app-server — not part of the default deterministic suite: session/create + session/read PASS, no session/send, no provider request). Fake-server tests could not catch this; the earlier 'synthetic config works' claims were only valid for the historical real-config-derived runs.

G0.validatedPortion: workspace/readState is a side-effect-free Catalog source: session/list count unchanged across calls; returns modelCatalog + full settings (models with reasoning levels, supportsImages, contextWindow, labels) + slashCommands. catalog.list/resolve must still prove zero inner session/create in WP2 contract tests (they do).
G0.deferredPortion: none within scope; catalog freshness across real runtime upgrades is re-checked by canary scenarios.

G1.verdict: FAIL (Plan A) / fallback per frozen O2
G1.validatedPortion: --settings is documented in `zcode --help` but rejected by the 0.16.5 argument parser in all 6 forms/placements. Without CLI config, session/create fails deterministically with 'Model config is missing. Create <home>/.zcode/cli/config.json with an explicit model provider before running ZCode.' (-32603). The CORRECTED synthetic config (provider/model reference, placeholder key, unreachable loopback endpoint) is proven against the REAL app-server by the explicit canary test/real-app-server-lifecycle.canary.ts (entry test:real-app-server; session/create + session/read PASS; no session/send, no provider request, no quota).
G1.deferredPortion: Which user action regenerates ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (zcode login, desktop login, or manual editing) is NOT verified; readiness guidance therefore names the file and the required fact only, and Gian never writes ~/.zcode (frozen O2).

G2.verdict: PARTIAL (static validated; live DEFERRED to authorized canary)
G2.validatedPortion: interaction/requestPermission params schema extracted from bundle: {requestId, sessionId, turnId?, toolCallId, toolName, reason, riskLevel: low|medium|high|critical, input?, origin?, options[>=1]}; option = {optionId, kind, name, description?, response} where response = {decision: allow|deny|escalate|modify, reason?, permissionUpdates?: [...]}. Faithful round-trip = echo the selected option's exact response payload. Reverse-request default timeout constant yCt=15e3 sits beside the preferences schema; ZCODE_E2E_ASK_USER_QUESTION_CLOCK_SCALE exists as a test hook. The adapter implements the exact-payload round-trip against the fake server (WP2 tests).
G2.deferredPortion: Live human-delay verification (20-30s) against a real tool approval -> explicit authorization point; per frozen O3, production enablement of interaction stays blocked, and the capability remains undeclared unless the canary opt-in env is set.

G3.verdict: PARTIAL (schema frozen; live DEFERRED to authorized canary)
G3.validatedPortion: session/send params = {sessionId: string, content: string, attachments?: array}; content is a plain string (arrays/objects rejected -32602); the attachments key exists and accepts items (loose item validation).
G3.deferredPortion: A real image/file turn plus model-conditioned rejection -> authorization point. input.localImage/localFile capabilities stay undeclared until then.

G4.verdict: PARTIAL (idle semantics validated; next-send effect DEFERRED to authorized canary)
G4.validatedPortion: Idle set* are deterministic with read-back: session/setModel {model:{providerId,modelId}} (unknown model -> -32603 with a bounded available-models list); session/setMode {mode: plan|build|edit|yolo|auto} mutates BOTH settings.mode.current and settings.permission.mode (ZCode 'mode' IS the permission mode; specialCatalogs.approvalMode mapping justified); session/setThoughtLevel param is {thoughtLevel: string} — NOT 'level' (Revision 1 wrong). Failure shapes are typed; bad values leave state unchanged. New sessions inherit lastUsed model.
G4.deferredPortion: That the applied snapshot actually governs the NEXT real send (and rollback-under-failure on a live turn path) requires a real turn -> authorization point.

G5.verdict: DEFERRED (design compatible; live determinism = authorized canary)
G5.validatedPortion: A retained Revision-1 probe log (log-final-1787938277649.ndjson) shows stop racing natural completion with terminal resultType 'success' — the race is real, and the adapter maps by (interrupt accepted AND causally cancelled) -> interrupted, observed success -> completed, other cancelled -> cancelled (WP2 tests cover the mapping). session/stop returns {} immediately.
G5.deferredPortion: Long-tool cancel determinism against a live turn requires a real model call -> authorization point.

G6.verdict: PARTIAL (replay shape/identity validated; live/replay equivalence DEFERRED to authorized canary)
G6.validatedPortion: Persisted sessions need resume before read; session/events replay is THIN (title/session-lifecycle only; seq cursor continues); full history = session/messages with info.anchor.turnId as the stable native turnId equal to the live computer-use turnId; tool parts carry callID/tool/state{status,input,output,metadata.serialization}. Replay merge = messages (content spine) + events. The adapter implements the merge and the projector tests assert stable ids across refetch.
G6.deferredPortion: Canonical fingerprint equality between LIVE and replay projections for one real turn -> authorization point. NOTE: the G6 probe is STATEFUL (session/resume may persist a session.resumed event); it fails closed without WP0_ALLOW_STATEFUL_PROBES=1.
G6.repro: WP0_ALLOW_STATEFUL_PROBES=1 node probes/wp0/probe-g6-replay.mjs (explicit authorization required; probe-owned /tmp sessions only)

G7.verdict: PARTIAL (core ownership semantics validated; running/desktop-active conflicts DEFERRED to authorized canary)
G7.validatedPortion: Inner session/close on an EMPTY session purges it permanently (read/resume -> -32004, gone from session/list). Sessions WITH history survive close and process exit (visible/resumable from a fresh app-server). Error taxonomy: 'Session is not active' (persisted, not loaded) vs 'Session not found' (unknown/purged). create(sessionId) is only legal for 'imported history creates'. Outer session.close therefore NEVER calls inner close: detach = unsubscribe + drop adapter state.
G7.deferredPortion: Running-session and desktop-active ownership conflict behavior (external turn detection -> fail/detach/quarantine/history.changed) requires live contention -> authorization point.

G8.validatedPortion: Execution closure = the whole glm resource directory (343 files, 46 MB, includes zcode.cjs + bundled plugins/ + .node-bundle-meta.json). Fingerprint = sha256 over sorted (relativePath, fileSha256) pairs; any file change invalidates the runtimeKey and retires the generation. The Host adapter reproduces the same closure-hash approach.

productDecisions.O1: superseded in practice: G0 found a side-effect-free catalog source (workspace/readState); the bootstrap Catalog remains the fallback only while readState reports the unconfigured vocabulary (available=0 / zcode-unconfigured).
productDecisions.O2: triggered: --settings is not viable on 0.16.5; readiness returns generic repairable invalid naming ~/.zcode/cli/config.json and the missing explicit model provider (no unverified login-command claim); Gian never writes ~/.zcode.
productDecisions.O3: armed: interaction is implemented behind the canary-only GIAN_ZCODE_ENABLE_INTERACTION opt-in for canary verification, but the capability is undeclared by default and production enablement stays blocked until the 20-30s human-delay gate passes live.
